title: Inside Mark Zuckerberg’s Decision to Pull the Trigger on Meta’s A.I. Agent
summary: Meta had delayed releasing Muse, its A.I. agent app, for months over safety concerns. Then new competition forced Mr. Zuckerberg’s hand.
